text: Walk up to the Parade and press E to buy the Brainrot on show.
title: Buy a Brainrot

text: Deposit your Brainrot in your booth and it earns you money every second.
title: Fill your booth

text: Steal Brainrots from rival booths, then lock your own booth and press Q to shield it.
title: Steal and defend

text: Rebirth once your booth is full to earn a permanent income multiplier.
title: Rebirth
